description: Migrate 500 GB of session and cache data from a self-managed Memcached cluster (6 nodes, 64 GB each) to a managed Redis Cluster (ElastiCache, 10 r6g.xlarge nodes) with dual-write pattern for zero-downtime cutover. Application code must write to both caches during migration phase and read from Memcached until cutover. After validation, flip reads to Redis and decommission Memcached. Risk factors: serialization format differences (Memcached uses raw bytes, Redis may benefit from structured types), TTL semantics differences, Redis memory fragmentation under high churn, dual-write latency doubling write time, and cache miss storms during cutover if Redis is cold. Must verify cache hit rates remain above 95% post-migration. Tools available: Redis-Shake, ElastiCache, custom dual-write library, Grafana dashboards, Redis RDB analysis tools.
